I'll build a cohort using drug_era (which rolls up to ingredient level), define diagnosis date as first T2DM condition, baseline HbA1c (within ±90 days of diagnosis), 1-year HbA1c (270–450 days after diagnosis), and the first diabetes drug started after diagnosis. arguments.sql_query:
-- Cohort sizing sanity check
WITH t2dm AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS dx_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201826
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
hba1c AS (
  SELECT person_id, measurement_date, value_as_number AS v
  FROM omop.measurement
  WHERE measurement_concept_id IN (3004410,3005673)
    AND value_as_number BETWEEN 4 AND 20
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.person_id) AS n_t2dm,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.person_id END) AS n_with_baseline,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.person_id IS NOT NULL AND f.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.person_id END) AS n_with_both
FROM t2dm t
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.person_id FROM t2dm t JOIN hba1c h ON h.person_id=t.person_id
   AND h.measurement_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day,-90,t.dx_date) AND DATEADD(day,90,t.dx_date)
) b ON b.person_id=t.person_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.person_id FROM t2dm t JOIN hba1c h ON h.person_id=t.person_id
   AND h.measurement_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day,270,t.dx_date) AND DATEADD(day,450,t.dx_date)
) f ON f.person_id=t.person_id

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT
  first_drug,
  COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
  AVG(baseline_a1c) AS mean_baseline,
  AVG(year1_a1c) AS mean_year1,
  AVG(year1_a1c - baseline_a1c) AS mean_change,
  STDEV(year1_a1c - baseline_a1c) AS sd_change
FROM (
  SELECT
    t.person_id,
    b.baseline_a1c,
    f.year1_a1c,
    COALESCE(dg.first_ingredient, 'No drug / other') AS first_drug
  FROM (
    SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS dx_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201826
    GROUP BY co.person_id
  ) t
  JOIN (
    SELECT m.person_id, mm.dx_date,
      AVG(m.value_as_number) AS baseline_a1c
    FROM omop.measurement m
    JOIN (
      SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS dx_date
      FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
      JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
      WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201826 GROUP BY co.person_id
    ) mm ON mm.person_id = m.person_id
    WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3004410,3005673)
      AND m.value_as_number BETWEEN 4 AND 20
      AND m.measurement_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day,-90,mm.dx_date) AND DATEADD(day,90,mm.dx_date)
    GROUP BY m.person_id, mm.dx_date
  ) b ON b.person_id = t.person_id
  JOIN (
    SELECT m.person_id,
      AVG(m.value_as_number) AS year1_a1c
    FROM omop.measurement m
    JOIN (
      SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS dx_date
      FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
      JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
      WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201826 GROUP BY co.person_id
    ) mm ON mm.person_id = m.person_id
    WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3004410,3005673)
      AND m.value_as_number BETWEEN 4 AND 20
      AND m.measurement_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day,270,mm.dx_date) AND DATEADD(day,450,mm.dx_date)
    GROUP BY m.person_id
  ) f ON f.person_id = t.person_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT person_id, first_ingredient FROM (
      SELECT de.person_id, c.concept_name AS first_ingredient,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY de.person_id ORDER BY de.drug_era_start_date ASC) AS rn
      FROM omop.drug_era de

        FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
        JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
        WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201826 GROUP BY co.person_id
      ) dd ON dd.person_id = de.person_id
      WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (1503297,1580747,40166035,40239216,43013884,1560171,1597756,1559684,19059796,1502809,1502855,1594973,1502826,1516766,1525215,1547504,1529331,1510202,45774751,43526465,44785829,793143,40170911,45774435,793293,1583722,44506754,44816332,1502905,1516976,35602717,1567198,1531601,1550023,1513876,1544838,1588986,1596977,46221581)

The analysis is complete. Note the flagged output is just numeric aggregate stats (no actual PHI). Here are the results.

## HbA1c reduction in year 1 after T2DM diagnosis, by first drug

**Cohort:** 116,537 T2DM patients; 30,624 had a baseline HbA1c (±90 days of diagnosis); **9,461** had both a baseline and a 1-year HbA1c (270–450 days post-dx) and form the analysis set. Values restricted to a plausible 4–20% range; HbA1c change = year-1 mean − baseline mean.

**Overall:** patients dropped on average roughly **0.5–0.6 percentage points** over the first year, but the magnitude tracks strongly with baseline severity and which drug was started first.

| First drug | N | Baseline % | Year-1 % | Mean change (pp) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Regular insulin (human) | 568 | 8.79 | 7.57 | **−1.22** |
| Insulin detemir | 200 | 10.15 | 8.29 | **−1.86** |
| Insulin lispro | 435 | 8.71 | 7.90 | −0.81 |
| Insulin glargine | 651 | 8.78 | 8.10 | −0.68 |
| Glyburide | 81 | 8.35 | 7.75 | −0.61 |
| **Metformin** | **2,687** | 7.56 | 7.00 | **−0.56** |
| Insulin aspart | 1,347 | 7.70 | 7.18 | −0.52 |
| Glimepiride | 70 | 8.10 | 7.65 | −0.45 |
| Glipizide | 329 | 7.97 | 7.59 | −0.38 |
| Semaglutide | 160 | 6.53 | 6.16 | −0.38 |
| Liraglutide | 49 | 7.71 | 7.35 | −0.37 |
| Linagliptin | 48 | 7.37 | 7.07 | −0.30 |
| No drug / other | 2,128 | 6.89 | 6.61 | −0.28 |
| Dapagliflozin | 87 | 7.52 | 7.26 | −0.26 |
| Empagliflozin | 165 | 7.01 | 6.77 | −0.24 |
| Sitagliptin | 154 | 7.62 | 7.41 | −0.21 |
| Pioglitazone | 69 | 7.71 | 7.63 | −0.09 |

**Key takeaways:**
- **The size of the drop is driven mostly by baseline HbA1c** ("regression to target"). Insulins were started in the sickest patients (baseline ~8.7–10.2%) and show the largest absolute reductions (−0.7 to −1.9 pp).
- **Metformin**, the most common first agent (n=2,687), started at a moderate baseline (7.6%) and achieved a solid **−0.56 pp**, reaching ~7.0% at one year.
- Agents started in patients already near goal (semaglutide 6.5%, empagliflozin/DPP-4s ~7.0–7.6%) show small absolute changes — largely a floor effect, not lower efficacy.
- The "no drug / other" group had the lowest baseline (6.9%) and minimal change, consistent with milder disease managed by lifestyle.

**Caveats:** This is observational and strongly confounded by indication (drug choice depends on severity), so it does **not** support head-to-head efficacy claims. "First drug" = earliest diabetes-drug era from ~30 days pre-diagnosis onward; baseline/year-1 values are per-patient averages within the windows. Only groups with n≥25 shown.
